items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy 'what if' geography Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how cool this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy), build excitement through each line, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Plot twist' gets a playful, knowing, excited lift. 'But look closely at their flags.' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'Twice.' lands as its own dry beat after a tiny pause. 'that doesn't exist.' is delivered slowly and softly, like a bittersweet punchline. The last line trails off unfinished on 'Because honestly...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy, about 175 words per minute, short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Accent: native General American English narrator, neutral American accent from the first word to the last. Pronounce 'Nicaragua' as 'nik-uh-RAH-gwuh', 'Honduras' as 'hon-DOOR-us', 'Costa Rica' as 'KOH-stuh REE-kuh'. Read ONLY the text provided, word for word, every line in order; never add words of your own.
lines: What if Central America... Was one country?
In eighteen twenty-three, Five of these countries Became one nation.
The Federal Republic Of Central America.
So what if All seven merged today?
Fifty-three million people... In a country Bigger than Spain.
Coasts on two oceans... And the Panama Canal.
So why did The first one fail?
In eighteen thirty-eight, Nicaragua walked out. Then Honduras... Then Costa Rica.
By eighteen forty-one, The country was gone.
They tried to reunite Again and again... And failed every time.
But look closely At their flags.
Blue, white, blue. The old federation's colors.
And Honduras kept Five stars: One for each old member.
A flag still hoping For a country That doesn't exist.
And Honduras has Just one thing to say.
So... one Central America, Or seven countries? Because honestly...
